event.title: the bob is born
event.description: bob is born five minutes after midnight, on the 28th day of December

event.title: the bob sprays Lysol into their eyes
event.description: bob picks up a can of Lysol trying to figure out what it is, and accidentally presses down on the sprayer while scrutinizing the nozzle up close. exact location can no longer be found on google maps

event.title: There is no Year Zero!
event.description: There is no Year 0 on an AD - BC timeline because the monks who came up with the AD and BC timeline concept were working with Roman numerals and did not have a concept of a 0.

event.title: Julius Caesar invades Britain
event.description: Julius Caesar led the first Roman expedition to Britain, landing on the Kent coast.

event.title: Battle of Actium
event.description: Octavian defeated the combined forces of Mark Antony and Cleopatra, becoming Rome's first emperor.

event.title: Storming of the Bastille
event.description: Parisian crowds stormed the Bastille fortress, marking the start of the French Revolution.

event.title: Declaration of the Rights of Man
event.description: The National Constituent Assembly adopted this foundational document of human rights.

event.title: Execution of Louis XVI
event.description: King Louis XVI was guillotined at the Place de la Révolution in Paris.

event.title: Napoleon crowned Emperor
event.description: Napoleon Bonaparte crowned himself Emperor of the French at Notre-Dame de Paris. His first reign as Emperor ends when he abdicates in 1814
